en.title: Dam'a (Egyptian Tomato Sauce)

steps.n1: Lightly sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then add the tomato puree and cook until thickened.
steps.n2: Add the tablespoon of vinegar and stir well, then add the water and season with salt and pepper, leaving it to simmer until boiling.
